planets.name: WASP-3 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-3 with a 1.85-day year, found in 2007.

text.card: WASP-3 b was found in 2007 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-3. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2007, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 1.846835096, pl_radj 1.42, pl_bmassj 2.43

quotes.title: WASP-3b
quotes.card: WASP-3b is an extrasolar planet orbiting the star WASP-3 located approximately 800 light-years away in the constellation Lyra.
quotes.introduction: It was discovered via the transit method by SuperWASP, and follow up radial velocity observations confirmed that WASP-3b is a planet.
